g.text: ADR-0046 — a deck rewritten while two windows show it: one read, verified, numbered, fanned out
a burst of writes: one read, one trailing read
change × 3 → the read is marked DIRTY
tail → body → fstat on the same handle:
[still changing, and a notification will announce the next write]
pending — the requesters wait for the next read
[stable but incomplete (a LaTeX error), or changing with no notification coming]
it KEEPS it, behind a note
the trailing read, and a late arrival
pdf replace-doc! in place, the slide kept
a read that lands late with seq ≤ the applied one is DROPPED —
main: change source, content-flight, verified reader
u = 250 ms; seq is minted only by main.
